jobPostingInfo.title: University, 2027 Summer Games Data Scientist Intern - Rome, NY
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Scheduled to obtain a Bachelor’s degree in a Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics field by Summer 2028 or Summer 2029.

The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD).

Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person.

Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently.

Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility.
